platform.title: 座舱 AI 评测平台
platform.summary: 按车型与系统版本，查看 AI 总体表现、指标得分、场景任务完成率与测试视频。将结果与交互过程放在一起，理解能力优势与体验差距。
points: 车型对标
从总体评分到功能域表现，比较不同受测版本的能力结构。
指标与场景
按指标和具体任务查看成绩，识别复杂条件、连续对话与服务执行中的差距。
视频与证据
回到测试视频与评分记录，理解每一次任务的结果和过程。
platform.access: 完整平台包括车型对比、指标与场景详情、测试视频及对应评分记录。
platform.note: 匿名样本 A · 既有报告快照 · 满分 5 分

en.title: BeeEVAL Data: Look Beyond the Score
en.summary: Compare vehicles and software versions, explore domain scores and task completion, then review the video behind each result. Understand both what the AI achieved and how it got there.
points: Compare vehicles
See how tested versions differ, from the overall score to individual domains.
Investigate the gaps
Explore metrics and tasks to find where complex requests, follow-up conversations or service execution break down.
Review the evidence
Watch the test video alongside its evaluation to understand the result in context.
en.access: The full platform includes vehicle comparisons, detailed metrics and scenario results, test videos and their evaluation records.
en.note: Anonymous vehicle A · Existing research snapshot · Scores out of 5

scenes.title: AI与车，共同打开新的场景。
scenes.summary: 从用户需求出发，连接 AI 能力、车用条件与场景价值。研究候选场景、行业应用与人机交互过程，为评测任务和预研验证提供方向。
points: 场景与用户价值
了解谁在什么情境下遇到什么问题，以及场景可能带来的帮助。
行业应用与研究依据
结合公开应用、相关专利与适用条件，理解场景的机会与边界。
交互与验证
查看触发、澄清、确认、执行和反馈的具体流程，以及失败恢复与用户停止方式。
scenes.access: 完整场景库包括详细定义、研究依据、行业应用、相关专利与 HAI 交互流程。
scenes.note: 以下为研究候选的概念预览，量产适用性与用户价值仍需验证。

samples.name: 可追问的车窗世界
samples.summary: 乘客可围绕刚才路过的建筑、标识或景物连续追问，车辆利用短时现场线索定位对象并解释。例如问“刚才那座塔”，找到画面并支持追问历史。

samples.name: 会解释的车辆守护
samples.summary: 车辆持续观察约定的车外事件，把发生过程整理成有证据的摘要，并区分值得通知与可忽略事件。例如有人多次靠近车门，推送关键片段供车主判断是否处理。

samples.name: 多乘员舒适协商
samples.summary: 不同席位表达冷热、日晒和声音诉求，AI整理分歧并提出可确认的共同舒适方案。例如前排冷、后排热，询问可接受范围后分区调节。

en.title: BeeScene: From User Needs to Product Ideas
en.summary: Explore how AI could help in specific in-car situations. Connect user needs, vehicle conditions and interaction design to guide product research and prototype validation.
points: Start with the user
Understand who needs help, in what situation, and what a useful outcome would look like.
Explore the evidence
Review public applications, relevant patents and operating conditions to understand the opportunity and its limits.
Make the interaction testable
Examine triggers, clarification, confirmation, execution and feedback, including failure recovery and user control.
en.access: The full library includes scenario definitions, research references, industry applications, relevant patents and detailed interaction flows.
en.note: These are research concepts. Production suitability and user value still need to be validated.

samples.name: Ask About the World Outside
samples.summary: Let passengers ask follow-up questions about a building or landmark they just passed. The concept uses recent visual context to identify the subject and support further questions.

samples.name: Vehicle Monitoring That Explains What Happened
samples.summary: Turn agreed exterior events into an evidence-backed summary, helping the owner decide what needs attention. For example, show key clips when someone repeatedly approaches a door.

samples.name: Finding Comfort Across Seats
samples.summary: Bring together passengers’ requests about temperature, sunlight and sound. Clarify acceptable ranges before proposing changes across cabin zones.
